<hr>
<h3 data-id="heading-0">一、为什么“清缓存”成了技术圈的梗？</h3>
<p>“老师，页面白屏了！”<br>
“清下浏览器缓存试试。”<br>
—— 这段对话每天都在各家公司重复上演。<br>
用户不会理解「缓存」是什么，他们只会觉得“你们网站又出 Bug 了”。<br>
更尴尬的是，90% 的线上“旧代码”问题，确实只靠<strong>强制刷新</strong>就能解决。<br>
于是前端背锅，用户流失，产品经理发飙。</p>
<p><strong>根源</strong></p>
<ol>
<li>静态资源走「强缓存」（Cache-Control/Expires），服务器都收不到请求。</li>
<li><code>index.html</code> 本身也被缓存，导致 <code>chunk-vite-abc123.js</code> 404 却没人知道。</li>
<li>发版窗口没做「灰度 + 版本兜底」，一挂全挂。</li>
</ol>
<p><strong>目标</strong><br>
让用户<strong>永远</strong>不再看到旧代码，同时<strong>永远</strong>不再听到“清缓存”三个字。</p>
<hr>
<h3 data-id="heading-1">二、先给缓存“把个脉”：浏览器到底缓存了谁？</h3>



































<table><thead><tr><th>缓存位置</th><th>谁控制</th><th>典型场景</th><th>是否可 JS 感知</th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><td>Memory Cache</td><td>浏览器</td><td>同一会话后退/刷新</td><td>❌</td></tr><tr><td>Disk Cache (HTTP 缓存)</td><td>Response Header</td><td>强缓存 200(from disk)</td><td>❌</td></tr><tr><td>Service Worker Cache</td><td>开发者代码</td><td>PWA 离线包</td><td>✅</td></tr><tr><td>Push Cache</td><td>HTTP/2</td><td>已废弃</td><td>❌</td></tr></tbody></table>
<p><strong>结论</strong><br>
只有 Service Worker 能让前端“自己管自己”，其余都<strong>无法</strong>在出错时主动清理。<br>
因此「让用户清缓存」本质是<strong>把不可控因素甩给用户</strong>——极不专业。</p>
<hr>
<h3 data-id="heading-2">三、设计思路：把“发版”做成“自愈”</h3>
<ol>
<li><strong>版本号</strong> → 可对比<br>
每次 CI 在全局注入 <code>__APP_VERSION__ = '1.2.3-beta.1+202509211100'</code></li>
<li><strong>服务器</strong> → 永远返回最新 <code>index.html</code>（<code>Cache-Control: no-cache</code>）</li>
<li><strong>前端</strong> → 轮询版本号，发现不一致即<strong>主动 reload</strong>并跳过缓存</li>
<li><strong>兜底</strong> → 若 JS 抛错 404，同样触发 reload</li>
<li><strong>灰度</strong> → 只有带 <code>?v=latest</code> 的 5% 流量走新版本，出错自动回滚</li>
</ol>
<hr>
<h3 data-id="heading-3">四、代码落地（Vue3 + Vite 为例，React/Angular 同理）</h3>
<h4 data-id="heading-4">1. CI 注入版本</h4>
<pre><code class="hljs language-bash" lang="bash"><span class="hljs-comment"># .github/workflows/release.yml</span>
<span class="hljs-built_in">echo</span> <span class="hljs-string">"export const APP_VERSION = '<span class="hljs-variable">${GITHUB_REF_NAME}</span>+<span class="hljs-subst">$(date +%Y%m%d%H%M)</span>';"</span> &gt; src/meta/version.js
</code></pre>
<p>vite.config.ts</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-ts" lang="ts"><span class="hljs-keyword">import</span> { defineConfig } <span class="hljs-keyword">from</span> <span class="hljs-string">'vite'</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">import</span> { <span class="hljs-variable constant_">APP_VERSION</span> } <span class="hljs-keyword">from</span> <span class="hljs-string">'./src/meta/version'</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">export</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">default</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">defineConfig</span>({
  <span class="hljs-attr">define</span>: {
    <span class="hljs-attr">__APP_VERSION__</span>: <span class="hljs-title class_">JSON</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">stringify</span>(<span class="hljs-variable constant_">APP_VERSION</span>),
  },
})
</code></pre>
<h4 data-id="heading-5">2. 版本轮询模块（src/core/version-guard.ts）</h4>
<pre><code class="hljs language-ts" lang="ts"><span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> <span class="hljs-variable constant_">VERSION_CHECK_INTERVAL</span> = <span class="hljs-number">60_000</span> <span class="hljs-comment">// 1min</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> <span class="hljs-variable constant_">RETRY_MAX</span> = <span class="hljs-number">3</span>

<span class="hljs-keyword">async</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">function</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">fetchMeta</span>(<span class="hljs-params"></span>) {
  <span class="hljs-comment">// 加 search 防止自身被缓存</span>
  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> res = <span class="hljs-keyword">await</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">fetch</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'/meta.json?t='</span> + <span class="hljs-title class_">Date</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">now</span>())
  <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> res.<span class="hljs-title function_">json</span>() <span class="hljs-keyword">as</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">Promise</span>&lt;{ <span class="hljs-attr">version</span>: <span class="hljs-built_in">string</span> }&gt;
}

<span class="hljs-keyword">export</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">function</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">startVersionGuard</span>(<span class="hljs-params"></span>) {
  <span class="hljs-keyword">let</span> retry = <span class="hljs-number">0</span>
  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">loop</span> = <span class="hljs-keyword">async</span> (<span class="hljs-params"></span>) =&gt; {
    <span class="hljs-keyword">try</span> {
      <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> { version } = <span class="hljs-keyword">await</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">fetchMeta</span>()
      <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (version !== __APP_VERSION__) {
        <span class="hljs-comment">// 发现新版本</span>
        <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> event = <span class="hljs-keyword">new</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">CustomEvent</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'sw-update'</span>, { <span class="hljs-attr">detail</span>: { version } })
        <span class="hljs-variable language_">window</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">dispatchEvent</span>(event)
        <span class="hljs-comment">// 立即刷新，skipWaiting 效果</span>
        location.<span class="hljs-title function_">reload</span>()
      } <span class="hljs-keyword">else</span> {
        retry = <span class="hljs-number">0</span>
      }
    } <span class="hljs-keyword">catch</span> (e) {
      <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (++retry &gt;= <span class="hljs-variable constant_">RETRY_MAX</span> &amp;&amp; <span class="hljs-keyword">import</span>.<span class="hljs-property">meta</span>.<span class="hljs-property">env</span>.<span class="hljs-property">PROD</span>) {
        <span class="hljs-comment">// 可能 index.html 都是旧的，强制硬刷新</span>
        location.<span class="hljs-property">href</span> = location.<span class="hljs-property">href</span> + <span class="hljs-string">'?v='</span> + <span class="hljs-title class_">Date</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">now</span>()
      }
    }
  }
  <span class="hljs-built_in">setInterval</span>(loop, <span class="hljs-variable constant_">VERSION_CHECK_INTERVAL</span>)
  <span class="hljs-title function_">loop</span>() <span class="hljs-comment">// 立即执行一次</span>
}
</code></pre>
<h4 data-id="heading-6">3. 404 兜底（src/core/error-tracker.ts）</h4>
<pre><code class="hljs language-ts" lang="ts"><span class="hljs-variable language_">window</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">addEventListener</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'error'</span>, <span class="hljs-function">(<span class="hljs-params">e</span>) =&gt;</span> {
  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> src = e.<span class="hljs-property">filename</span> ?? <span class="hljs-string">''</span>
  <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (<span class="hljs-regexp">/chunk-.*\.js$/</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">test</span>(src) &amp;&amp; e.<span class="hljs-property">message</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">includes</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'Failed to fetch'</span>)) {
    <span class="hljs-comment">// 旧 chunk 404</span>
    sessionStorage.<span class="hljs-title function_">setItem</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'force-reflow'</span>, <span class="hljs-string">'1'</span>)
    location.<span class="hljs-property">href</span> = location.<span class="hljs-property">href</span> + <span class="hljs-string">'?v='</span> + <span class="hljs-title class_">Date</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">now</span>()
  }
})
</code></pre>
<h4 data-id="heading-7">4. index.html 永不缓存</h4>
<pre><code class="hljs language-nginx" lang="nginx">location = /index.html {
  add_header Cache-Control "no-cache, no-store, must-revalidate";
}
</code></pre>
<h4 data-id="heading-8">5. 资源文件长期缓存 + 内容哈希</h4>
<pre><code class="hljs language-ts" lang="ts"><span class="hljs-comment">// vite 默认 chunk-[hash].js，确保文件名一变就 404，触发兜底</span>
build.<span class="hljs-property">rollupOptions</span>.<span class="hljs-property">output</span>.<span class="hljs-property">entryFileNames</span> = <span class="hljs-string">'static/js/[name]-[hash].js'</span>
</code></pre>
<hr>
<h3 data-id="heading-9">五、灰度 &amp; 回滚：把“爆炸半径”缩到最小</h3>
<ol>
<li>边缘层（CDN/Nginx）按 Cookie 或 Query 分流<br>
<code>if ($arg_v = latest) { proxy_pass http://new-bucket; }</code></li>
<li>前端报错统一上报 Sentry，1 分钟错误率 &gt; 0.2% 自动回滚（CI 调用 CDN 回源接口切流）</li>
<li>用户侧：版本不一致时先弹<strong>柔性提示</strong>“检测到新版本，3 秒后自动刷新”，避免突兀。</li>
</ol>
<hr>
<h3 data-id="heading-10">六、最终效果</h3>
<ul>
<li>发版后 60s 内，<strong>所有在线用户</strong>静默切换到最新代码。</li>
<li>用户本地缓存的 <code>chunk-abc123.js</code> 404 → 自动硬刷新，<strong>零人工介入</strong>。</li>
<li>客服再也没收到“页面空白”的工单。</li>
<li>产品经理主动在群里点赞：“最近怎么没人报 bug 了？”</li>
</ul>
<hr>
<h3 data-id="heading-11">七、常见疑问 Q&amp;A</h3>
<p><strong>Q1. 轮询不会增加服务器压力吗？</strong><br>
/meta.json 只有 200B，1 分钟一次，1 万日活一天才 1k×60×24 ≈ 1.4M 请求，静态文件 CDN 0.01 元/万次，成本忽略不计。</p>
<p><strong>Q2. 移动端后台标签长时间不刷新怎么办？</strong><br>
监听 <code>visibilitychange</code>，切回前台立即检查版本；再配合 Service Worker 的 <code>clients.claim()</code> 可瞬间激活新代码。</p>
<p><strong>Q3. 企业内网无法联网，怎么更新？</strong><br>
内网场景建议把 <code>index.html</code> 做成 <code>no-cache</code>，发版通知用户<strong>刷新当前页</strong>即可；其余资源仍走哈希缓存，平衡速度与可靠性。</p>
<hr>
<h3 data-id="heading-12">八、结语：把“清缓存”写进历史</h3>
<p>“清缓存”本质是<strong>把技术债转嫁给用户</strong>。<br>
只要做到：</p>
<ol>
<li>版本可感知</li>
<li>入口文件无缓存</li>
<li>旧资源 404 能兜底</li>
<li>灰度可回滚</li>
</ol>
<p>就能让发版像“热更新”一样丝滑。<br>
下次再有人让你“清缓存”，请把这篇博客甩给他，并温柔地说：<br>
“不用，我们网站自己会洗澡。”</p></div></div>
